description: This file defines the DisabledModuleController class within the OrangeHRM system. It extends AbstractVueController and implements a preRender method that initializes a Vue component named 'disabled-module'. It serves to handle the logic for a disabled module view within the HR system.

classes.name: DisabledModuleController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling the display of a disabled module within the HR system. It extends AbstractVueController and sets up a Vue component on preRender.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Overridden method that initializes a Vue component named 'disabled-module' and associates it with the controller.
